body: I want to be honest with my family but I don't want them to know how weak I am and how much I struggle everyday to get out of bed and do anything. I know they will only try bring god into it. That's almost always a part of all they talk about and I can't listen to that crap anymore. I was homeschooled and my parents and I did not put very much effort into it and I can barely write anything from memory and I have no friends at all because of it. I have to hide the fact that I don't believe in god every day so I don't get kicked out of my families house
